items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Henry Ford was one of the original bass players with King Cole.

ctx.x: Well, I remember, it was Jimmy introducing somebody, his nephew, and I thought maybe Henry Ford was in the same group. Yeah, Henry Ford's a bass player. Yeah. I guess not.
Henry Ford was one of the original bass players with King Cole.
Did you do any recording? No.
